title: Dubstep: UKF half-time, melodic dubstep, riddim, brostep
doc: Dubstep components (C minor, 140 bpm half-time, one cycle = one bar): kick and half-time snare, sub (edm-core), Reese, FM formant growl, synced wobble, talking bass, riddim bass, screech and laser leads, supersaw chords, pluck, arp, lead, atmosphere pad and synthesised vowel chops; forms reuse the edm-core 104-bar gates; four feel templates (halftime, ukf, riddim, brostep).
racksDoc: Dubstep racks (band-scoped, docs/RACK_STANDARD.md): dsKick, dsSnare, reeseBass, growlBass, wobbleBass(sync), talkBass, riddimBass, screechLead, laserZap, ukfChord, ukfPluck, ukfArp, ukfLead, atmosPad, vowelChop. Growl layers start at 80-90 Hz: put subSine (racks-edm-core) under them.

atomsIngredient.title: Dubstep atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/edm dubstep atoms (ds.): half-time, brostep and riddim drum patterns, hat accents, sub / growl / wobble / reese / riddim / talk bass lines, wobble rates, the Cm7 Abmaj7 Ebmaj7 Bb7 loop with arp, pluck, lead, chop, screech and laser lines; call / response and 4th-bar fill masks. Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-dubstep").

section.title: Dubstep: half-time, UKF melodic, riddim, brostep
section.explain: Dubstep in pack glyphcore/edm (docs/EDM_REFERENCES.md). 140 bpm, one cycle = one bar, kick on the 1 (and the and of 3), snare alone on beat 3. Bass is layered: subSine plays the fundamental, the growl / wobble / reese / riddim layer starts at 80-90 Hz, so drive never muddies the sub. Wobble is the superdough low-pass LFO synced to the bar (lpsync: periods per bar). Four feels (feel-halftime, feel-ukf, feel-riddim, feel-brostep) fill the same template slots as the hip-hop feels.

dsKick.doc: dubstep kick: sine body near 48 Hz, 30-semitone drop over 60 ms, 400 ms decay, shape for punch; high-pass 42 Hz (two kicks a bar put pitch-envelope sidebands under 20 Hz, rack audit)

dsSnare.doc: half-time snare: triangle body on D3 stacked with white noise, high-pass 150 Hz, 220 ms, light shape; the one big hit on beat 3

reeseBass.doc: Reese: two saws 0.3 semitone apart (+-15 cents, the beating is the sound), mono (spread 0), low-pass 900 Hz with a short envelope, light shape

growlBass.doc: FM formant growl (mid layer over a separate sub): saw with FM at ratio 1 whose index decays, a vowel formant filter per note, distortion after the filters; high-pass 90 Hz leaves the fundamental to the sub

wobbleBass.doc: wobble: saw + square through a resonant low-pass whose LFO is synced to the bar (`sync` per bar: 4 quarters, 8 eighths, 6 / 12 triplets), shape after it; high-pass 120 Hz at 24 dB/oct (the band split: the sub plays below; at 12 dB/oct a G1 fundamental leaked -20 dB, rack audit)

talkBass.doc: talking bass: saw with FM at ratio 2 through an 'o' formant, a 1/16 synced low-pass LFO (16 per bar) and soft distortion: the vocal yoi / talk movement

riddimBass.doc: riddim: hollow square with FM at ratio 0.5 (a sub-octave modulator), resonant low-pass 900 Hz, short and repetitive, heavy shape; the space between hits is part of the sound

screechLead.doc: screech: saw with FM at a slightly inharmonic ratio 3.01 (a beating edge), index decays to 0.5, high-pass 400 Hz, distortion 1.2 (2 put the drive asymmetry under 20 Hz, rack audit), fast vibrato

laserZap.doc: laser: a saw that falls two octaves in 120 ms (pitch envelope), 180 ms long; the pew between bass hits

ukfChord.doc: melodic dubstep chords: 7-voice supersaw, 0.35 semitone detune, 0.7 spread above a 200 Hz high-pass

ukfPluck.doc: UKF pluck: saw + square, 250 ms, low-pass 1.8 kHz with a 2-octave envelope

ukfArp.doc: arp: triangle, 150 ms, filter envelope 2 octaves

ukfLead.doc: melodic lead: 3-voice supersaw, low-pass 3.5 kHz, 15 ms attack, vibrato 5 Hz at 0.12 semitone

atmosPad.doc: atmosphere pad: 5-voice supersaw, 2 s attack, 3 s release, filter opens over 3 s

vowelChop.doc: vowel chop (synthesised, no sample): a saw through a vowel formant that changes per note, 120 ms stab

halfKick2.doc: half-time kick with the and of 3

broKick.doc: brostep kick: 1, the a of 1, the and of 3, the and of 4

riddimKick.doc: riddim kick: 1 and the and of 2

ghostSnare.doc: ghost snares around the backbeat (the a of 2, the a of 4)

dsHats.doc: 8th hats: the standard meter over half-time drums

subLine.doc: sub roots, one per bar, C minor (i i VI VII)

growlLine.doc: growl rhythm: 8ths and 16ths with gaps (the gaps make the groove)

wobbleSync.doc: wobble rates per bar: quarters, eighths, quarters then 16ths, triplets

riddimLine.doc: riddim: 3 + 3 + 2 sixteenths, twice; repetition and space

chords.doc: melodic dubstep loop: Cm7 Abmaj7 Ebmaj7 Bb7 (i VI III VII)

arp.body: <[c4 eb4 g4 c5]*4 [ab3 c4 eb4 ab4]*4 [eb4 g4 bb4 eb5]*4 [bb3 d4 f4 bb4]*4>

leadLine.body: <[c5 ~ bb4 g4 ~ g4 bb4 c5] [eb5 ~ d5 c5 ~ bb4 g4 ~] [g5 ~ f5 eb5 ~ d5 eb5 ~] [f5 ~ eb5 d5 ~ bb4 ~ ~]>

screechLine.doc: screech answers in the bass gaps

laserLine.doc: one laser per bar, in a gap

lastOf4.doc: the 4th bar of every 4: the drop fill

recipes.title: Half-time drums at 140
recipes.intent: Kick on the 1 and the and of 3, the snare alone on beat 3, 8th hats: the half-time pulse under a 140 bpm meter.

recipes.title: Dubstep kick
recipes.intent: Deep sine kick with a punchy pitch drop on the half-time 1.

recipes.title: Half-time snare
recipes.intent: Triangle body plus noise on beat 3, with ghost snares around it.

recipes.title: Reese bass
recipes.intent: Two saws 0.3 semitone apart beating against each other, mono, low-passed.

recipes.title: Sub + growl (band split by layering)
recipes.intent: A clean sine sub plays the fundamental, an FM formant growl an octave up starts at 90 Hz: the low end stays clean while the mids snarl.

recipes.title: FM formant growl
recipes.intent: Saw with an FM index that decays, a vowel formant per note and distortion after the filters.

recipes.title: Wobble (synced filter LFO)
recipes.intent: Held roots through a resonant low-pass whose LFO is synced to the bar; the rate changes per bar: quarters, eighths, 16ths, triplets.

recipes.title: Talking bass
recipes.intent: FM saw through an 'o' formant with a 16th-note filter LFO: the bass seems to speak.

recipes.title: Riddim bass
recipes.intent: A hollow square with a sub-octave FM modulator in a 3+3+2 pattern; the space between hits is the groove.

recipes.title: Screech lead
recipes.intent: FM saw at an inharmonic ratio with distortion and fast vibrato, answering in the bass gaps.

recipes.title: Laser zap
recipes.intent: A saw that falls two octaves in 120 ms, once per bar in a gap.

recipes.title: Melodic dubstep chords
recipes.intent: Cm7 Abmaj7 Ebmaj7 Bb7 on a wide 7-voice supersaw, high-passed at 200 Hz.

recipes.title: UKF pluck figure
recipes.intent: Saw + square pluck outlining the chord loop.

recipes.title: 16th arp
recipes.intent: Triangle arp through the chord loop.

recipes.title: Melodic lead
recipes.intent: 3-voice supersaw lead with vibrato over the loop.

recipes.title: Atmosphere pad
recipes.intent: Slow supersaw pad for intros and breakdowns.

recipes.title: Vowel chops (synthesised)
recipes.intent: A saw through a vowel formant that changes per note: a chopped vocal hook without samples.

recipes.title: Call and response basses
recipes.intent: Bar A is the growl, bar B the talking bass: two basses share the drop without masking each other.

recipes.title: Drop with a 4th-bar fill
recipes.intent: Three bars of drop, then a bar where the bass stops and a laser and snare fill lead back to the 1.

recipes.title: Dubstep tutorial track (104 bars, 11 lessons)
recipes.intent: A 3-minute half-time dubstep track that teaches itself: intro, build, drop A, breakdown, build 2, drop B with a switch-up, outro; every section is a lesson in the code comments.
recipes.notes: The whole track: Craft form (packs, atoms, racks as .hook) and its generated Strudel form (track.standalone.strudel.js, paste-ready). Map, lessons and measured numbers: docs/tracks/edm-dubstep-tutorial/README.md.

syntax.title: Pick a dubstep feel (one import line)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:feel-halftime", { as: "feel" })   // or feel-ukf, feel-riddim, feel-brostep
hooks.bind("kick", atoms.feel.kickRack)
hooks.bind("snare", atoms.feel.snareRack)
hooks.bind("perc", atoms.feel.percRack)
hooks.bind("hats", atoms.feel.hatsRack)
hooks.bind("top", atoms.feel.topRack)
hooks.bind("bass", atoms.feel.bassRack)
hooks.bind("harmony", atoms.feel.harmonyRack)
hooks.bind("fx", atoms.feel.fxRack)
kick: s(atoms.feel.kick).velocity(atoms.feel.kickVel).use("kick", { mode: "swap" })
snare: s(atoms.feel.snare).velocity(atoms.feel.snareVel).use("snare", { mode: "swap" })
perc: s(atoms.feel.perc).velocity(atoms.feel.percVel).use("perc", { mode: "swap" })
hats: s(atoms.feel.hats).velocity(atoms.feel.hatsVel).use("hats", { mode: "swap" })
top: note(atoms.feel.top).velocity(atoms.feel.topVel).use("top", { mode: "swap" })
bass: note(atoms.feel.bass).velocity(atoms.feel.bassVel).use("bass", { mode: "swap" })
harmony: note(atoms.feel.harmony).velocity(atoms.feel.harmonyVel).use("harmony", { mode: "swap" })
fx: s(atoms.feel.fx).velocity(atoms.feel.fxVel).use("fx", { mode: "swap" })

syntax.title: Drop as layers: sub + growl, the kick ducks both
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-dubstep"); atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-core")
kick: s(atoms.ds.halfKick2).hook("dsKick | sidechain(2, 0.36, 0.15)")
snare: s(atoms.ds.halfSnare).hook("dsSnare")
sub: note(atoms.ds.subLine).hook("subSine | ducked(2)")          // fundamental: clean, mono
growl: note(atoms.ds.growlLine).hook("growlBass | ducked(2)")    // mids from 90 Hz: FM, formant, drive

syntax.title: Wobble rate as a pattern (lpsync)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-dubstep")
wob: note(atoms.ds.wobbleLine).hook("wobbleBass").lpsync("<4 8 [4 16] 6>")   // LFO periods per bar
sub: note("<c1 c1 eb1 g1>").hook("subSine")

syntax.title: Switch-up in drop B (one slot, two basses by gate)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-dubstep")
hooks.bind("bass", "growlBass", "<3b"); hooks.bind("bass", "riddimBass", "@3b")
bass: note("[c2 c2] ~ [c2 ~ c2 c2] [eb2 ~ g1 ~]").use("bass", { mode: "swap" })
kick: s(atoms.ds.halfKick2).hook("dsKick")
snare: s(atoms.ds.halfSnare).hook("dsSnare")

syntax.title: Growl on a bus: band-split drive (.split)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-dubstep")
growl: note(atoms.ds.growlLine).s("sawtooth").fm(2).fmh(1).fmdecay(0.25).fmsustain(0.3).vowel("<a o>").lpf(3200).attack(0.005).gain(0.4)
  .split(lo => lo.lpf(100).hpf(30),                             // fundamental stays clean
         hi => hi.hpf(100).distort(1.2).postgain(0.45).lpf(9000)) // drive the mids, scope the top after the drive
sub: note(atoms.ds.subLine).hook("subSine")

halftime.title: Half-time dubstep
halftime.doc: kick on the 1 and the and of 3, the snare alone on beat 3, 8th hats in the standard meter, a held sub and a dark pad

ukf.title: UKF melodic dubstep
ukf.doc: half-time drums, wide supersaw chords, a melodic lead and a clean sub: emotion over weight

riddim.title: Riddim
riddim.doc: sparse drums, a hollow repetitive bass in 3+3+2 with the gaps as the groove, one laser per bar, no chords

brostep.title: Brostep
brostep.doc: busier kicks, 16th hats, an FM formant growl with screech answers in its gaps
